name: @neuropause/environment-provisioning
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Version 1.1 Program 1C: Production Environment Provisioning. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14, Sprints 1-6, Launch Workstreams 1-5, and Version 1.1 Programs 1A-1B, unchanged, into a governed provisioning-orchestration layer that uses the Program 1B automation to provision a real production environment through a strict Preview → Approval → Provision → Validation → Evidence flow: a prerequisite gate that STOPS and returns 'PENDING - OPERATOR INPUT REQUIRED' whenever a required operator input (cloud provider, cloud credentials reference, domain, container registry, DNS zone, TLS authority, secrets manager, approval) is missing; a cloud provisioning runtime for AWS/Azure/GCP/self-hosted with Preview (never provisions), approval-gated Apply (prepares only — provisioned stays false until an operator applies out-of-band with real credentials), and Rollback; infrastructure/Kubernetes/database/DNS-TLS/secrets/deployment/monitoring provisioning planners that reuse the Program 1B generators; an acceptance validator producing machine-readable reports (every check pending until real infrastructure answers); an evidence-promotion engine (timestamp/operator/command/result/artifact/audit-id — never auto-promoted); an operations dashboard distinguishing Pending/Provisioning/Failed/Verified; and governance. The provisioning runtime, prerequisite gate, all provisioning planners, the acceptance validator, the evidence-promotion engine, the dashboard, and governance are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; AWS/Azure/Google Cloud, Terraform, Helm, and cert-manager are ADAPTER-VERIFIED; provisioning runs, cluster health, acceptance results, and monitoring data are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and cloud accounts, provisioned VPC/cluster/databases, DNS zone, TLS certificate, and production deployment are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. No cloud account, DNS ownership, certificate, successful deployment, monitoring datum, production traffic, or customer usage is ever invented; provisioning is approval-gated, reversible, and evidence-backed, and no capability moves to Verified without real evidence. Every provisioning activity is recorded on the one governance chain with a replay id.
